title: Stimulus-response signaling dynamics characterize macrophage polarization states.
authors: Singh, Apeksha; Sen, Supriya; Iter, Michael; Adelaja, Adewunmi; Luecke, Stefanie; Guo, Xiaolu; Hoffmann, Alexander
one_liner_zh: 该文研究巨噬细胞极化状态下NF-kB信号动态，虽涉及转录因子但聚焦细胞信号响应而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且方法为机器学习时间序列分析，无DNA结合位点或互作机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The functional state of cells is dependent on their microenvironmental context. Prior studies described how polarizing cytokines alter macrophage transcriptomes and epigenomes. Here, we characterized the functional responses of 6 differentially polarized macrophage populations by measuring the dynamics of transcription factor nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) in response to 8 stimuli. The resulting dataset of single-cell NF-kappaB trajectories was analyzed by three approaches: (1) machine learning on time-series data revealed losses of stimulus distinguishability with polarization, reflecting canalized effector functions. (2) Informative trajectory features driving stimulus distinguishability ("signaling codons") were identified and used for mapping a cell state landscape that could then locate macrophages conditioned by an unrelated condition. (3) Kinetic parameters, inferred using a mechanistic NF-kappaB network model, provided an alternative mapping of cell states and correctly predicted biochemical findings. Together, this work demonstrates that a single analyte's dynamic trajectories may distinguish the functional states of single cells and molecular network states underlying them. A record of this paper's transparent peer review process is included in the supplemental information.
abstract_zh: 细胞的功能状态依赖于其微环境背景。先前的研究描述了极化细胞因子如何改变巨噬细胞的转录组和表观基因组。在此，我们通过测量转录因子核因子κB（NF-kappaB）对8种刺激的动态响应，表征了6种差异极化巨噬细胞群体的功能反应。所得的单细胞NF-kappaB轨迹数据集通过三种方法进行分析：（1）对时间序列数据进行机器学习，揭示了极化过程中刺激可区分性的丧失，反映了效应功能的固化。（2）识别了驱动刺激可区分性的信息性轨迹特征（“信号密码子”），并用于绘制细胞状态图谱，该图谱随后能够定位由无关条件处理的巨噬细胞。（3）利用机制性NF-kappaB网络模型推断的动力学参数，提供了细胞状态的替代映射，并正确预测了生化发现。综合来看，这项工作表明，单一分析物的动态轨迹可能区分单细胞的功能状态及其背后的分子网络状态。本论文透明同行评审过程的记录包含在补充信息中。
